answer: Cap admission with a 20-epoch identity trellis: each agent locks 70 POA and completes four unpredictable jobs per round, with a 4-of-7 established jury signing the receipts. One failed round freezes rewards; two failures slash half the marble bond. Funding-linked identities require bonds that double at every branch, so a clone ocean becomes exponentially expensive. Anyone can replay the job hashes, jury signatures, timestamps, and funding graph to verify enforcement.
